name: TO&HI: Vspomnit' vsjo. Viktorina na vyzhivanie
original_name: TO&HI: Вспомнить всё. Викторина на выживание
source:
This is a quiz game featuring Torako and Hitsuji.
It is the first Ren'Py visual novel which was originally written in Russian (2008).
Info from gamer.ru/ren-py/obzor-to-hi-vspomnit-vsyo-viktorina-na-vyzhivanie
